bios: I started {business} at my kitchen table and now serve neighbors all over {hood}. I love work that keeps me close to the block.
Born and raised in Queens. After ten years in Manhattan offices I came home and opened {business}. I believe the best clients come from people who know you.
I moved to {hood} from abroad with two suitcases and a plan. {business} is that plan, a few years and many good neighbors later.
Mother of two, small-business owner, and a firm believer that women here should hire each other first. Ask me about {business}.
{business} is a one-woman shop with a lot of heart. I care about doing things properly and explaining them in plain words.
I spent years learning my craft and now teach it too. At {business} everyone is welcome, beginners most of all.
Community first. I joined the collective to meet the women behind the shops I walk past every day in {hood}.
I run {business} from {hood} and work with families and businesses across western Queens. Referrals are how I grow, and I love sending them too.
Former teacher turned founder. {business} grew out of what neighbors kept asking me for.
I speak three languages and use all of them at {business}. Happy to help anyone navigating the city in theirs.
